ModelSelector.note: Ported from ComposerModelSelectorControl: emphasizeLabel two-tone pill with ProviderIcon-slot icon, ChevronDown trailing, and a second row exercising the detail slot. Label reads in the active colour against muted icon/detail as designed.

ActiveAndDetail.note: active vs default vs disabled with label+detail. The active/default delta is subtle by design (composer-control-active-foreground vs composer-control-foreground) but present, and disabled is clearly dimmed.

IconOnly.note: iconOnly=true renders three 28px square controls with sr-only labels; placed on a composer-background bar so the affordance boundary is visible rather than three floating glyphs.

ControlRow.note: The real ChatInputControlRow cluster — model + stateful mode + two icon-only controls — on one line inside the composer surface at max-w-2xl. No wrapping or truncation.
